note: Let F(a,b,c)=a^3+b^3+c^3-3abc and Q(a,b,c)=a^2+b^2+c^2-ab-bc-ca. Direct expansion gives F(a+t,b+t,c+t)=F(a,b,c)+3tQ(a,b,c). Seeds (1,0,0), (0,1,1), (2,0,1) have (F,Q) equal to (1,1), (2,1), (9,3), hence their nonnegative diagonal translates yield 3t+1, 3t+2, 9(t+1). Zero is F(0,0,0).

If 3|F, then a+b+c=0 mod3. Such residue triples are either all equal or a permutation of (0,1,2). Cubes mod9 depend only on residue mod3 and are respectively 0,1,-1. In the equal case the cube sum and 3abc are both 3r^3 mod9; in the permutation case both are 0 mod9. Thus 9|F.
